concept: Speaking up when you see something unfair, even in a small way
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character notices something unfair happening to someone else and decides to speak up about it
exercise.reflection_prompt: What made it hard for the character to speak up, and what helped them do it anyway?
exercise.practice: Student names one way they could speak up if they saw something unfair

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific, age-appropriate way of speaking up
